feeds.description: Discover the century-old traditions behind Italy's wine-making and food production, learn about the distinct culture of each region, uncover destinations and attractions off the beaten track, that will shine the light on a completely new face of Italy. feeds.title: Vinoway

Immerse into a world of exclusive Wine, reviews, Food recipes, News event reports, special articles and much more.

feeds.title: insidewine
feeds.description: Explore the world of wine inside and outside the glass. Inside Wine delves into the intricate landscapes of the mind, where thoughts, emotions, and experiences converge. The blog serves as a refuge of knowledge, offering insights into the nuances of mental health conditions, their origins, and strategies for management and recovery.

feeds.title: Francesco Selicato
feeds.description: Explore this amazing beer blog: fascinating stories and valuable advice written by Beer Blogger Francesco Selicato. Enter the world of beer like never before! AS a published author on the topic, Francesco dives into the beautiful intricacies of the beer industry. His goal is to guarantee you an unparalleled sensory experience every time you choose to enjoy a beer.

feeds.title: Oscarwine
feeds.description: Welcome to oscarwine: take a seat, choose your favorite story and taste it with us. Oscarwine tells stories of wine, because behind every glass there are fatigue, sacrifices, joy and extraordinary anecdotes.

feeds.title: Le Strade del Vino Sardegna
feeds.description: Le Strade del Vino Sardegna is a thematic site on the world of wine in Sardinia, a point of reference for wine enthusiasts, those in the sector, or the simply curious. It contains a collection of Sardinian wineries, distilleries, liqueur factories and craft breweries, from the big producers to the lesser known ones and their respective products. A container full of news, events and thematic areas concerning the world of Sardinian wine.

feeds.title: The Wine Economist » Italian wine

Mike Veseth is editor of The Wine Economist and author of more than a dozen books including Wine Wars (2011) and Around the World in Eighty Wines (2018).

feeds.description: We are a creative wine group made of lawyers, engineers, digital content creators connected by the same great passion: wine. The Decanto wine blog, on a journey in search of the best wineries to visit, rare wines to review and typical recipes to match.

feeds.title: Roscioli Italian Wine Club Blog
feeds.description: Browse & read all the posts in the Roscioli Italian Wine Club blog including Wine Club tasting notes, articles about winemakers & classic Italian recipes. feeds.title: xtraWine Blog

feeds.title: The Italian Wine Girl

feeds.title: Santo Vino Wine Blog

feeds.title: learnitalianwines by tom hyland
feeds.description: A guide to Italian wines, grapes and producers. I am a freelance wine writer and photographer specializing in the wines of Italy. I live in Chicago and recently completed my 77th trip to Italy. I have visited virutally every region in the country and am constantly amazed at the wonderful variety of wines produced from indigenous grapes (I am never amazed at the quality of the wines!). I have been in the wine business for 40 years, have been writing for 20 years and have been a professional photographer for the past twelve years.

feeds.title: Wine-Today » Italy

feeds.title: The Italian Wine Job Blog
feeds.description: A wine enthusiast, writer, translator, judge and trainer based in Budapest. I offer translation, editing and writing services relating to wine. Managing Editor of WineSofa, member of the Circle of Wine Writers, holder of the WSET diploma, Weinakademiker, Vinitaly Italian Wine Ambassador and Expert and Judge at the International Wine Challenge, Berliner Wine Challenge and Vinitaly's FiveStarWines. Passionate about Hungarian and Italian wine, but the whole world is my oyster.

feeds.title: Scenic Wine Tours in Tuscany Blog
feeds.description: Tuscan Wine Blog by Sergio of Scenic Wine Tours in Tuscany features articles on Tuscany wines, guides for Italian wines and more. This is where you'll enjoy private travel, a private table at your wine tastings, and the exclusive attention of your guide for the day. The theme for all my excursions is an equal balance between wine tasting, and contemplation of the stunning Tuscan scenery.

feeds.title: Italian Wine Discovery

feeds.title: Tannina » Stories of Wine
feeds.description: My name is Anna Corrù, author of this wine blog and I am AIS Sommelier. At the beginning that with wine was a pleasant relationship for me, there was sympathy, even of feeling, at times but if I told you that I was immediately struck by it, I would lie to you. I hope that between the lines of this Blog that talks about wine, the soul of a wine , its voice, its essence, its vibrant emotionality, its hidden side, that secret that is revealed only to a trusted confidant, get to the heart.

feeds.title: Percorsi di Vino
